translations.web: The whole assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept another seven days with gladness.
translations.bsb: The whole assembly agreed to observe seven more days, so they observed seven days with joy.
translations.kjv: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.
